# INTEGRATION MATRIX: every system with every other system (D1141, generated by S6919)

Rule (Marlon 11-03): everything integrates with everything. Train fuelled by mana is the model case. This file lists, for every pair of systems in the pack, at least one real interaction, built on a few universal bridges so nothing is a one-off.
Source of truth: `cloud/integration/matrix_data.py` in Global-Repo (what each system gives and takes). Re-run S6919 after editing it. Sits beside plans/INTEGRATION.md (module definition of done) and plans/UNITS.md (units).

## 1. The universal bridges (build these once, every system plugs in)

| Id | Bridge | Currency / unit | Lives in | Rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| E | Energy | J, W | diaithir-units (ScaledEnergy), NeoForge energy capability | Every powered block and every store reads and writes J. Magic, fuels, batteries, heat and food all convert to J through one carrier table. |
| F | Fuel and carrier | MJ per L or kg | diaithir-units Fuels, Engine, FuelStore | Any prime mover lists carriers it accepts (coal, diesel, hay, mana, battery). Mana is a carrier at 100 J per quantum. Same engine class in car, train, ship, plane or mega vehicle. |
| L | Fluid | L (1 mB = 1 L) | NeoForge fluid handler, `c:` fluid tags | One tag per fluid (`c:<fluid>`, `c:gases`, `c:molten_<metal>`). Potions, essences, fuels, coolant, water and air are all fluids any tank or pipe may carry. |
| M | Material | kg, `c:` item tags | almostunified, `c:` tags, diaithir-bridges | One canonical item per material. Recipes take tags. Every ingot, plate, gem, crop and reagent is a tag member in every system that can use it. |
| C | Cargo | kg, m3 | Storage and logistics module, VS2 mass | Everything has mass and volume. Containers, pallets, wagons, holds and bays carry any item or fluid; ship and vehicle mass changes handling. |
| S | Signal | redstone level, OC2R bus | circuits and computers module | Every working block gives a comparator level and a computer port; any block may be switched or read by a circuit, a computer or an autonomy controller. |
| W | Labour | NPC job, wage in g Ag | NPC and wages module | Every machine class has an operator job; every NPC job maps to a station. Wages are paid in coin, so labour is priced the same everywhere. |
| U | Upgrade module | slot, grade | diaithir-upgrades Resolver | Every working block takes the same module kinds (speed, efficiency, yield, quality, range). Beacons stack across systems. |
| H | Heat | K, J | Foundry heat grid, climate | Waste heat of every engine and machine is energy in J and a temperature in K. Heat warms rooms, cooks food, drives steam, and shapes climate. |
| P | Place | bar, K, g (m/s2), lux | planets module | Each planet sets atmosphere pressure, temperature, gravity and light. Machines, engines, crops, mobs and magic read them. |
| A | Animation | clip, rig, IK | animation module | Every working machine, vehicle and NPC job has clips driven by its state (running, loaded, firing, harvesting). |
| K | Knowledge | Codex node, research pack, quest, Age | Codex, progression web | Each system adds nodes, research pack recipes and quests that unlock the next system; the Panscriptum entry lists the in-game form. |
| G | Money | g Ag | economy module | Price follows material value, energy in J and labour in g Ag. Vendors, contracts, tariffs and wages use the same table. |
| V | Event | Global Events bus, calendar year | Global Events (#111) | Weather, plague, raid, festival, war, boom and disaster events reach every system through one bus on the shared calendar. |

All are designs on paper; section 5 says what is built.

## 4. Pairs

Each pair: a concrete interaction (`*`) is a concrete design. A pair marked CHANNEL has the bridge both systems already plug into, listed as `[bridge] giver > taker: what it gives; what it takes`; it is a ticket for the owning lanes to turn into a concrete recipe, block or NPC job, not a finished design. Age rule: an interaction unlocks at the later of the two systems' Ages and is gated by the same recipe or station as the thing it uses.

### MAG Magic schools (Botania, Ars, Embers, Blood, Aura, vis)
- **ELE**: * Tobardealain turns mana into J on the grid, Lochrandraoidheachd turns J into reagent; both ways lose a set fraction, so the magic-tech loop never makes free energy. | [E] ELE>MAG: J and W on poles, meters, storage tiers; J to make reagents through Lochrandraoidheachd | [F] MAG>ELE: magic quanta as an engine carrier for an arcane motor; fuel carriers burned in generators
- **FLU**: * Potions, essences and liquid mana are `c:` fluids; any pipe, tank or tanker carries them, and a still can separate them. | [E] MAG>FLU: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; J for pumps, stills and electrolysis | [M] MAG>FLU: reagents, runes, enchant dust as tagged items; crops and biomass to ferment
- **FUL**: * Magic quanta are a row in the fuel table (100 J each); an engine class lists them as an accepted carrier. | [E] FUL>MAG: shaft work in W at the real efficiency of each engine class; J to make reagents through Lochrandraoidheachd | [L] MAG>FUL: potions, essences and liquid mana as `c:` fluids; liquid fuels in L
- **HEA**: * Fire and frost spells add or remove J from the heat grid; an ember furnace burns ember quanta (100 J) as fuel and a ley vent can warm a greenhouse. | [E] HEA>MAG: steam turbines and thermoelectric cells; J to make reagents through Lochrandraoidheachd | [F] MAG>HEA: magic quanta as an engine carrier for an arcane motor; fuel to burn
- **MEC**: * Windmills and waterwheels run a mana pump or ritual wheel; a leyline-driven mill adds torque, converted at the 100 J quantum. | [E] MAG>MEC: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; J from motors | [E] MEC>MAG: torque N.m x rpm = W into the grid through a dynamo; J to make reagents through Lochrandraoidheachd
- **PNE**: * Air and aether are one gas family: a compressor can bottle ambient mana-air and a pneumatic line can carry it as `c:gases` pressure. | [E] MAG>PNE: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; J to compress | [E] PNE>MAG: compressed air stored in bar x L converts to J; J to make reagents through Lochrandraoidheachd
- **CAR**: * Cars and trucks take the same arcane motor; a mana battery cell is a drop-in for a lead-acid one. | [E] CAR>MAG: starter and alternator feed a small battery; J to make reagents through Lochrandraoidheachd | [F] MAG>CAR: magic quanta as an engine carrier for an arcane motor; petrol, diesel, ethanol, battery, hay for carts
- **TRN**: * A locomotive with an arcane motor burns mana quanta (100 J each) from a rail-side ley tap or reagent tender; efficiency is a balance value, not real. Steam and diesel engines can burn the same quanta through the carrier table. | [E] MAG>TRN: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; overhead or third-rail J | [E] TRN>MAG: regenerative braking feeds the grid; J to make reagents through Lochrandraoidheachd
- **SHP**: * A Keelwright ship can fit an arcane drive fed from a ley tap or mana tank in the hold; sails stay free. | [F] MAG>SHP: magic quanta as an engine carrier for an arcane motor; diesel, coal, wood, battery, mana | [L] MAG>SHP: potions, essences and liquid mana as `c:` fluids; buoyancy and fresh water
- **AIR**: * An aircraft with an arcane motor flies on mana at a heavy mass penalty (tanks of quanta), rule set by the carrier table, not by hand. | [F] MAG>AIR: magic quanta as an engine carrier for an arcane motor; avgas, jet A-1, hydrogen or battery | [L] MAG>AIR: potions, essences and liquid mana as `c:` fluids; fuel at an airfield
- **MEG**: * Mega vehicles burn magic quanta in bulk from a hold of mana tanks, so a dig head can run off a ley line. | [E] MAG>MEG: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; power cables at MW | [E] MEG>MAG: on-board reactor feeds a colony grid; J to make reagents through Lochrandraoidheachd
- **PLN**: * Leyline density is a planet number; each planet's mana yield, spell strength and ritual sites follow from it. | [E] MAG>PLN: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; power for habitats | [F] MAG>PLN: magic quanta as an engine carrier for an arcane motor; propellant and fuels carried to orbit
- **STO**: hub: reagents and enchants moves and is stored as pallets and containers, counted in the storage network and carried by any vehicle with a hold. | [E] MAG>STO: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; J for conveyors | [L] MAG>STO: potions, essences and liquid mana as `c:` fluids; fluid tanks
- **ECO**: * Reagents, enchants and rites are priced in g Ag from the energy and materials they cost; vendors buy and sell them. | hub: reagents and enchants is priced in g Ag from material value, J and labour; vendors buy and sell it and tariffs apply. | [E] MAG>ECO: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; J priced per kJ | [F] MAG>ECO: magic quanta as an engine carrier for an arcane motor; fuel with a pump price
- **NPC**: hub: A druid or mage is a paid NPC job tied to the spell or rune, wage in g Ag, with food and housing needs. | [F] MAG>NPC: magic quanta as an engine carrier for an arcane motor; food and fuel rations | [M] MAG>NPC: reagents, runes, enchant dust as tagged items; tools and housing
- **RIT**: * Rites spend mana quanta and reagents as offerings; boss drops are the highest-value reagents. | [E] MAG>RIT: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; mana quanta as the offering | [E] RIT>MAG: boss kills release mana quanta; J to make reagents through Lochrandraoidheachd
- **FRM**: * Growth spells and fertiliser reagents raise yield; harvested herbs are reagents; mages cost wages like farmhands. | [E] MAG>FRM: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; J for pumps and lights | [L] MAG>FRM: potions, essences and liquid mana as `c:` fluids; irrigation water and fertiliser
- **FOD**: * Feast and brewing spells; potions are fluids the kitchen can use; mana-fed ovens and enchanted dishes carry set buffs. | [E] MAG>FOD: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; J for kitchens | [L] MAG>FOD: potions, essences and liquid mana as `c:` fluids; water and milk
- **BLD**: * Rune stones and warded walls use material classes by their real hardness; mana storage depends on the stone's matrix. | [E] MAG>BLD: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; J for kilns and saws | [M] MAG>BLD: reagents, runes, enchant dust as tagged items; ores and timber as input
- **CIR**: * A circuit pulse fires a ward or a rune; OC2R can read charge in a mana tank as a signal. | hub: A spell being cast exposes a comparator level and an OC2R port, so a circuit or computer can read and switch the spell or rune. | [E] MAG>CIR: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; J for compute | [M] MAG>CIR: reagents, runes, enchant dust as tagged items; chips and copper
- **AUT**: hub: The spell or rune can be driven by an autonomy module where its type allows it, replacing the druid or mage; Age alone does nothing. | [E] MAG>AUT: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; J for the module | [F] MAG>AUT: magic quanta as an engine carrier for an arcane motor; fuel and charge checks
- **MUN**: * Enchanted and mana-charged rounds use reagents as a component; casting a ward needs no rounds. | [E] MUN>MAG: propellant energy in J; J to make reagents through Lochrandraoidheachd | [F] MAG>MUN: magic quanta as an engine carrier for an arcane motor; propellant as a carrier
- **MIN**: * Mana-bearing ores (vis crystal, ember stone) mine like others; smelters take ember quanta as fuel and spells can detect veins. | [E] MAG>MIN: mana, aura, ember, LP and vis as 100 J quanta, Source 1000 J, out through Tobardealain; J for drills and arc furnaces | [F] MAG>MIN: magic quanta as an engine carrier for an arcane motor; coke, charcoal and diesel
- **MOB**: * Mana-bearing mobs drop quanta and reagents; spells tame, ward or summon Bestiary creatures with the same mob tags. | [E] MOB>MAG: mana-bearing mobs drop quanta; J to make reagents through Lochrandraoidheachd | [M] MAG>MOB: reagents, runes, enchant dust as tagged items; feed and bait
- **WLD**: * Leylines and mana-rich biomes are worldgen features; structures hold spell tomes and shrines on `c:is_<biome>` tags. | [M] MAG>WLD: reagents, runes, enchant dust as tagged items; mined resource to deplete | [M] WLD>MAG: ore veins, trees, ruins loot by Age; metals and gems as catalysts
- **CDX**: hub: Codex page for spell or rune in the Civilopedia from real source text, linking to the Codex page page and the other way. | [M] CDX>MAG: books as items with real page text; metals and gems as catalysts | [W] CDX>MAG: scribes and librarians; mages as paid NPC casters

### ELE Electricity grid and generators
- **FLU**: * Electrolysis splits water to hydrogen and oxygen; pumps and compressors take J; batteries use electrolyte fluids. | [E] ELE>FLU: J and W on poles, meters, storage tiers; J for pumps, stills and electrolysis | [F] FLU>ELE: refined diesel, petrol, kerosene, ethanol from crude; fuel carriers burned in generators
- **FUL**: * A generator is an engine class on the shared table: coal and wood to steam, diesel to a genset, hydrogen to a fuel cell, all at real efficiency. | [F] FUL>ELE: the shared fuel table and Engine classes (animal, steam, petrol, diesel, jet, electric, fuel cell); fuel carriers burned in generators | [M] ELE>FUL: wire, plate and cell items; solid fuels, charcoal, hay, oats
- **HEA**: * Steam turbines turn heat to J through the boiler grid; load heat and exhaust return to the heat grid in K. | [F] HEA>ELE: burnable fuel stock as heat store; fuel carriers burned in generators | [L] HEA>ELE: steam and hot water; water and steam for turbines
- **MEC**: * A dynamo turns torque times rpm into W on the grid; a motor does the reverse. | [E] ELE>MEC: J and W on poles, meters, storage tiers; J from motors | [M] MEC>ELE: gears, rods and belts; copper, iron and rubber items for cable
- **PNE**: * Compressors and air motors convert J to bar x L and back with a stated loss. | [E] ELE>PNE: J and W on poles, meters, storage tiers; J to compress | [L] PNE>ELE: air and hydraulic oil as tagged fluids; water and steam for turbines
- **CAR**: * Electric cars take the grid via chargers; a battery row (Li-ion 0.9 MJ/kg) sets range; regenerative braking returns J. | [M] ELE>CAR: wire, plate and cell items; steel, rubber, glass
- **TRN**: * Electric locomotives take overhead or third-rail J and return it by regeneration; substations tie to the grid in W. | [E] ELE>TRN: J and W on poles, meters, storage tiers; overhead or third-rail J | [M] ELE>TRN: wire, plate and cell items; rails, sleepers and steel
- **SHP**: * Ship generators, shore power and batteries; electric drive uses motor efficiency from the engine table. | [F] SHP>ELE: keel engines run on the shared carriers; sail needs none; fuel carriers burned in generators | [M] ELE>SHP: wire, plate and cell items; timber, plate, canvas
- **AIR**: * Aircraft carry a battery bus and generator in W; electric aircraft draw from chargers, and airfields have a grid tie for ground power and runway lights. | [M] ELE>AIR: wire, plate and cell items; aluminium, fabric, steel | [W] AIR>ELE: pilots and ground crew; linemen and plant operators
- **MEG**: * A mega vehicle needs a trailing cable or a reactor; its W draw is the largest on a grid. | [E] ELE>MEG: J and W on poles, meters, storage tiers; power cables at MW | [M] ELE>MEG: wire, plate and cell items; alloy plate for hull
- **PLN**: * Solar yield depends on the star's light and distance; a colony grid sits on its planet's day length. | [E] ELE>PLN: J and W on poles, meters, storage tiers; power for habitats | [L] PLN>ELE: atmosphere gases; water and steam for turbines

### HEA Heat, steam and climate

- **PLN**: * Each planet's ambient K sets heating or cooling load for every habitat and every engine's efficiency. | [E] HEA>PLN: steam turbines and thermoelectric cells; power for habitats | [F] HEA>PLN: burnable fuel stock as heat store; propellant and fuels carried to orbit
- **STO**: hub: heat in J moves and is stored as pallets and containers, counted in the storage network and carried by any vehicle with a hold. | [E] HEA>STO: steam turbines and thermoelectric cells; J for conveyors | [L] HEA>STO: steam and hot water; fluid tanks

Built: carrier table (`diaithir-units` Fuels/Engine) for fuels; Tobardealain and Lochrandraoidheachd (magic to FE and back), EU and air converters, molten tank (`diaithir-bridges`).
